preconditions.expression: graph is a special undirected graph with 2n vertices and 3n-2 edges
preconditions.description: The graph consists of two trees connected by n edges, with additional edges between odd and even vertices.

preconditions.expression: edges between odd and even vertices have weights w_{i, i+1}
preconditions.description: The weights of edges connecting odd vertices with even vertices are given by w_{1, 2}, w_{3, 4}, ..., w_{2n-1, 2n}.

preconditions.expression: for each edge (u, v) between odd vertices, there exists an edge (u+1, v+1)
preconditions.description: This implies a path structure where each edge between odd vertices is followed by an edge between consecutive odd vertices.
The graph is fully connected, meaning any pair of vertices can be reached from any other by following a sequence of edges.
The constraints on n, weights, and the number of queries are given.

postconditions.expression: for each query (u_i, v_i), the output is the length of the shortest path between u_i and v_i
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the sum of the weights of the edges along the shortest path between the given vertices.
